vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.short: Every night you pick a victim.
vampire.description: Each night you and the other vampires agree on one villager. By day you hide who you are. You win when vampires equal the number of living villagers.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: You have no special ability. Your weapons are your voice by day and your vote. The village wins when every vampire is hanged.

seer.name: Seer
seer.short: Each night you read one identity.
seer.description: Each night you pick a player and learn whether they are a vampire. When to speak up is your call — a seer who talks early dies early.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.short: Two protections for the whole game.
doctor.description: At night you shield a player from the vampire attack — but only twice in the whole game. You may protect yourself, never the same person two nights in a row, and it does not stop a hanging.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: You have no night action. If the vampires come for you the attack backfires: one of them quietly drops to plain villager and nobody dies that night. You can still be hanged by day.

detective.name: Detective
detective.short: You see who woke up at night.
detective.description: Each night you pick a player and the game tells you whether they woke that night. It never reveals the role or the team — someone awake could be the seer or a vampire.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: Once per game, during the day discussion, you cast your spell. Nobody hangs that day, a minute is added to the discussion, and the player you choose cannot wake that night. Nobody learns it was you.

vampireLord.name: Vampire Lord
vampireLord.short: Once, you turn someone into a vampire.
vampireLord.description: Once per game you turn a player at night; they learn it and join the team, but cannot join the kill that same night. Try it on the hunter and it backfires.

bloodWizard.name: Blood Sorcerer
bloodWizard.description: On two nights of the game you seal a non-vampire: they cannot wake or use their ability that night. Seal the hunter and it fails — and the hunter notices.

mistVampire.name: Mist Vampire
mistVampire.description: On a foggy night the seer and the detective never wake at all. Your first fog can be any night; after that you must wait two nights.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: You wake last. You steal the role of the player you choose; even a vampire drops to plain villager. From that moment you are that role — and on that team.
